plugins.name: creative-claw
plugins.description: AI image and video generation in chat: make images, videos, voiceovers, music and sound effects. Turn product photos into video ads for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts, with image to video, text to video, text to speech and voice cloning. Build UGC ads, product photoshoots, consistent characters and multi-shot films for social media and marketing. After adding, open the plugin's Connectors tab and sign in to Creative Claw.
